SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices in Vellore as a direct maker, not a reseller or marketplace listing. We have built modular steel cabins since 2009 and have completed 500+ projects across South India. Units for Vellore are fabricated at our Bangalore factory and dispatched by road to sites across the city, the Katpadi belt, and the SIPCOT Ranipet–Walajapet industrial corridor. Because the road distance is only about 220–250 km, most Vellore orders reach the site in 3–4 days once the build is ready.

A container office is a factory-built steel cabin that arrives ready to use. It gives you a clean, lockable, weather-proof workspace without the time, cost, and mess of on-site civil construction. For a region that runs on tanneries, leather and footwear units, BHEL and heavy engineering at Ranipet, auto-component makers, and warehousing along the Chennai–Bangalore corridor, a container office is the fastest way to put a site office, supervisor cabin, or security post exactly where the work is.

How we build our container offices

Every unit starts with a mild steel frame in IS 2062 structural steel, welded and treated to resist rust in Vellore's hot, dusty conditions. The base sits on a channel frame so the cabin stays off wet ground. Walls use insulated PUF sandwich panels, or cement board with rockwool, so the inside stays workable through the Tamil Nadu summer. The roof is profiled GI sheet with a slope for rain runoff. Flooring is marine ply with vinyl for office use, or chequered MS plate for heavy gate and store cabins. Standard fit-out covers electrical wiring with switches, points, LED lights and a distribution board, powder-coated windows with grille and shutter, and a steel or laminated door with a lock. We can add air-conditioning, toilets with plumbing, pantry units, and partition walls when the site needs them.

Common sizes for Vellore sites

Popular configurations are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft for a single supervisor or security cabin, 20×8 ft (the standard shipping-container footprint) for a site office that seats a small team, and 40×8 ft for larger project offices with two or three rooms. We also fabricate to custom dimensions when a plot or gate space demands it. Units can be single-room, multi-cabin, or stacked in double-decker form where ground space is tight — a common request at Ranipet SIPCOT plots and warehouse yards on NH48. If you are unsure of the size, tell us the headcount and the use, and we will suggest a layout.

Where they are used around Vellore

Buyers in the Vellore region use our cabins as construction site offices on building and road projects, supervisor and engineer cabins inside engineering units at Ranipet, gate and security cabins for tanneries and logistics yards, billing and store rooms for warehouses along the Chennai corridor, and admin offices for small manufacturing units in the Katpadi (632007) and SIPCOT Ranipet Industrial Estate (632403) belts. For teams that need purpose-built construction site office units, we build a hardened version with heavier flooring and extra power points.

Price factors and delivery

Container office price in Vellore depends on the size, the panel type (PUF costs more than cement board but insulates better), the flooring, and the add-ons like AC, toilet, or extra electrical load. Because every unit is made to order, we confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion rather than showing a fixed sticker price that would not match your actual build. Delivery to Vellore is charged at ₹3,000 where applicable, with road transit of about 3–4 days once the unit is ready. We also offer a 7-day return window, with return shipping paid by the customer. You can compare our specifications against any marketplace listing — the difference is that you are dealing with the factory that welds the frame, not an agent forwarding your enquiry.

Certifications and warranty

SAMAN Portable operates under ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and is registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our container offices carry a 5-year structural frame and base warranty, 1–2 years on finishing, and a 20–25 year engineered service life for the steel structure. These are real, verifiable credentials — the kind of manufacturer proof a marketplace listing page cannot show you.

Why buy from SAMAN

When you search for a container office on a directory or marketplace, you get a list of resellers competing on the same stock photos. When you enquire with SAMAN, you reach the manufacturer directly. That means honest specifications, real size options, transparent price factors, and a single point of accountability from fabrication to dispatch. You can see our wider full container office manufacturing range to understand the standards we build to, and our work in nearby hubs — our Chennai corridor container office builds, Coimbatore industrial cabin projects, and container office fit-outs around Trichy — shows the same quality reaches every Tamil Nadu site.

Frequently asked questions

Do you deliver container offices to Vellore and Ranipet?
Yes. We manufacture at our Bangalore factory and dispatch by road across Vellore city (632001), the Katpadi belt (632007), and the SIPCOT Ranipet–Walajapet industrial area (632403). Transit is usually 3–4 days once the unit is built, with delivery charged at ₹3,000 where applicable.

What sizes of container office are available for Vellore sites?
Common sizes are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft cabins, 20×8 ft site offices, and 40×8 ft project offices. We also build custom dimensions and double-decker units for plots where ground space is limited.

How much does a container office cost in Vellore?
Price depends on size, panel type, flooring, and add-ons like AC or a toilet. Since every unit is made to order, we confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion so the figure matches your exact build.

Can the container office be customized for our Vellore site?
Yes. We add AC, toilets, pantries, partitions, extra power points, and heavier flooring for gate or store use, and we match the layout to your headcount and the space at your site.

Talk to the manufacturer. For container offices anywhere in the Vellore and Ranipet region, call our South zone team on +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440, or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details for a made-to-order quote.
